ui.help.computer.p1: As a game does, the app reads the computer on its first opening (the processor, the cores and the memory, never how fast it runs at the moment) and picks a level: Basic, with 2 cores or fewer or under 4 GB of memory; High, with 4 cores or more and 8 GB or more; Medium, in between. At the Basic level the voice AI starts off.
ui.help.computer.p2: Settings › General › This computer shows what was read, the level and the button Adjust again to this computer, which puts everything the level decides back to its own, also what you changed by hand. If the app opens on a computer of another level, it asks before changing anything: what you chose by hand stays, and Not now does not ask again on that computer.
ui.help.computer.title: The computer's level
ui.help.editing.p1: Pause the video and click a line to select it. A double click on it, or Correct this line… in the right-click menu, opens the correction box in place of the subtitle: Enter saves, Esc cancels and Shift+Enter breaks the line.
ui.help.editing.p2: The Correct subtitles card, in the panel, also corrects each line's text and its start and end times. {keys} undo and redo the corrections, and Restore the original goes back to the file's text.
ui.help.editing.p3: Exporting the subtitle writes it as you see it, with the corrections and the sync, to a new .srt or .ass file. The corrections are kept in the app's folder and still apply when the video is renamed or moved.
ui.help.editing.title: Correcting and exporting subtitles
ui.help.intro: Everything the app can do, by subject. The keys mentioned are your profile's.
ui.help.karaoke.p1: The karaoke mode helps you practice speaking. After a long pause, the next subtitle shows a few seconds early, with a bar or a countdown until the actor speaks, and fills in as they speak.
ui.help.karaoke.p2: {key} trains the line again, and Repeat each line repeats every line 1 to 10 times. The minimum pause and the lead time are in Settings › Study; the colors of the fill and the bar, in Settings › Subtitles › Study subtitle.
ui.help.karaoke.p3: With the voice AI on, the fill follows the actors' voice. Without it, it follows an estimate from the line's syllables. It always finishes before the subtitle goes away.
ui.help.karaoke.title: Karaoke mode
ui.help.modes.p1: Translation on demand, the recommended mode, shows only the study subtitle, and {key} shows the translation when you need it. Both shows the two subtitles, and the same key hides the translation. Translation always visible shows both all the time.
ui.help.modes.p2: In Settings › Study, the translation key can toggle the translation or show it only while held. Each video's mode is chosen on the session screen and in the panel; the default is in the profile.
ui.help.modes.p3: To hear it again, {phrase} goes back to the start of the line, and {last} go back 3, 5 or 10 seconds.
ui.help.modes.title: Study modes and the translation key
ui.help.passages.p1: Mark the start of a passage with {start} and its end with {end}: the passage is saved and starts repeating. In the panel you can also pick it by its times or by the line on screen.
ui.help.passages.p2: The passage's options: fit to the lines, repeat nonstop with a gap between laps, progressive speed (0.75×, then 0.90×, then 1.00×), the subtitle ladder (both subtitles, then only the study one, then none) and a goal of laps.
ui.help.passages.p3: Saved passages stay with the video: they show on the session screen, in the panel and in the right-click menu, to study again, rename or delete.
ui.help.passages.title: Studying passages
ui.help.players.p1: The app plays videos in a free player installed on the computer: VLC, inside the app's window and with the volume up to 200%, or PotPlayer, in its own window. With neither, the session screen offers to install one by itself or to download it from the official site.
ui.help.players.p2: In Settings › Player, choose your preferred player, point to a player installed somewhere else or have the app look again.
ui.help.players.title: Players
ui.help.problems.p1: When something goes wrong, the message says why and what to do: a full disk, a read-only file or one in use, a player that does not answer. No correction is lost, and a settings file the app cannot read is never wiped: Settings tells so, and the app keeps a copy of it before writing over it.
ui.help.problems.p2: If the player closes midway, Watch again goes back to where you were. A subtitle early or late: see Sync. The wrong subtitle: switch it in the panel or add a file.
ui.help.problems.p3: To ask for help, Settings › Advanced › Diagnostics copies the versions, the screens and the player in use, and Open the folder shows the logs of the last days.
ui.help.problems.title: Problems and solutions
ui.help.profiles.p1: A profile keeps the languages, the subtitles, the study and the shortcuts. Create one for each language you study in Settings › General › Profile; a new one starts as a copy of the current one.
ui.help.profiles.p2: The profile's choices apply once you Save, but the open video already shows how they will look. The app's theme, accent color, font and text size, the control bar and the correction box are in Settings › Appearance and apply at once.
ui.help.profiles.p3: The app language, Portuguese or English, is in Settings › General and changes at once.
ui.help.profiles.title: Profiles and appearance
ui.help.shortcuts.p1: Every shortcut is in Settings › Shortcuts, with your profile's keys. To change one, click it and press the new keys; × leaves the command without a shortcut, and ↺ goes back to the default.
ui.help.shortcuts.p2: A shortcut has up to three keys: two modifiers and one key. Alt+Shift, the Windows key and Windows' own combinations are not allowed, and the right Alt only works alone. A shortcut that already belongs to another command is refused, naming it.
ui.help.shortcuts.p3: Shortcuts work in the video window and in the panel, outside text fields. The sync keys and the passage marks also work with the player in front. Fixed: with the video paused, a click selects a line; a double click corrects the line or toggles fullscreen; Alt+F4 closes the app.
ui.help.shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
ui.help.start.p1: Drag a video onto the window or use Open video. The app works best with .mkv and also opens .mp4, .avi, .mov and .wmv. Subtitles can come inside the video or in .srt, .ass or .vtt files next to it.
ui.help.start.p2: The session screen already suggests the study subtitle, the translation, the audio and the player. Check them, change what you like and click Watch. If you stopped midway, Resume from goes back to where you were.
ui.help.start.p3: On the first opening, the setup assistant asks for the app language, your languages, the study mode, the player and FFmpeg. It opens again in Settings › General › Setup assistant.
ui.help.start.p4: With Settings › Advanced › Open videos from Windows, right-clicking a video shows Watch with LingoReel, and the app joins Explorer's Open with; each video's default program stays the same.
ui.help.start.title: Getting started
ui.help.storage.p1: Everything stays on this computer, in the app's folder (Settings › Advanced › Open the folder): the settings, the profiles, each video's corrections (projects), the thumbnails (thumbnails) and the logs of the last 14 days (logs). Nothing is written to the film's folder.
ui.help.storage.p2: The app sends nothing to the internet; it only uses it when you ask it to install a player or FFmpeg. On the session screen, Forget everything about this video deletes the corrections, the sync, the passages and where you stopped.
ui.help.storage.title: Where the app keeps everything
ui.help.subtitles.p1: The app picks by itself the subtitle that best fits the video, by the language written in the text, not only by the file's name. With the voice AI and FFmpeg, it also listens to the film to find the subtitle whose timing matches the voice.
ui.help.subtitles.p2: Switch subtitles on the session screen, in the panel or in the right-click menu, without stopping the video, and add a file from any folder with Add a subtitle file…
ui.help.subtitles.p3: Both lines can be turned off, to watch without subtitles. The order (study on top or translation on top), the margins and each line's style are in Settings › Subtitles.
ui.help.subtitles.title: Subtitles
ui.help.sync.p1: If a subtitle comes early or late, move the study one with {primary} and the translation with {translation}. Holding the key takes a larger step.
ui.help.sync.p2: The video shows how much each subtitle moved; the notice can be turned off in Settings › General. The panel and the Sync menu also adjust them and go back to the file's timing. The sync is kept with the video.
ui.help.sync.title: Sync
ui.help.title: Documentation
ui.help.voice.p1: The voice AI is small, comes inside the app and runs only on this computer, offline and free. It notices when someone speaks in the film, so the karaoke mode follows the voice and the app picks the subtitle that matches the sound.
ui.help.voice.p2: With FFmpeg, free and optional, the app listens to the film ahead and makes the seek bar's thumbnails. Install or choose FFmpeg in Settings › Study › Actors' voice.
ui.help.voice.p3: On the battery, the AI and the thumbnails rest unless you ask otherwise. On a Basic level computer, the AI starts off; you can turn it on anyway, at your own risk.
ui.help.voice.title: Voice AI, FFmpeg and thumbnails
ui.help.watch.p1: With VLC, the video plays inside the app's window, with the control bar over it: play ({play}), back and forward ({seek}), frame by frame ({frames}), volume, speed, translation and fullscreen ({fullscreen}). Every tip shows the key.
ui.help.watch.p2: Hover the seek bar to see the thumbnail of that moment. The volume ({volume}) goes up to 200% with VLC, and the step of each press is in Settings › Playback.
ui.help.watch.p3: A right click on the video, or Shift+F10, opens the menu with everything: speed, audio, subtitles, sync, study modes, karaoke mode, passages, another video and settings.
ui.help.watch.p4: The ▤ panel beside the video has the Playback and Settings tabs, and its edge changes its width. With PotPlayer, the video plays in PotPlayer's own window, and the app draws the subtitles over it and shows the panel in its own window.
ui.help.watch.title: Watching
